title: Databricks Runtime 19: November 2, 2026
body:
### New features and improvements

* `ALTER SHARE ADD/ALTER VIEW` now accepts `WITH HISTORY` and `WITHOUT HISTORY`; existing history defaults are unchanged.

### Library and environment updates

* Updated Python libraries:
  + `pytz` from 2025.2 to 2026.5
  + `tzdata` from 2026.2 to 2026.5
